notes:
- Cleaner Car menu with live rainbow colours.
- Faster PlayStation controller overlay.
- Improved F2 opening and recovery.
- Fixed saved switches and Alpha Boost effects.
changelogNotes:
- Reorganized the Car menu into Wheels, Body and Effects with a simpler layout and a remembered selection.
- Added live body, primary/secondary decal, wheel and boost colours with optional rainbow modes. Boost colours also update the garage preview.
- Improved headlight colours and added small coloured lights around the headlight covers.
- Improved F2 input handling, held-key protection and recovery when the transparent menu fails to load. The menu follows the game's display and restores from a minimized state.
- Reduced PlayStation controller overlay latency by continuously reading USB/Bluetooth reports and displaying the latest state. Device discovery no longer blocks controller polling.
- Fixed Item Spawn and Underglow switches reverting or showing stale states across windows and restarts.
- Fixed stale Rainbow Alpha Boost effects after equipping another boost and improved its inventory name and thumbnail.
- Removed Clip Clipper from the app and its bundled recording tools.
